text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Warisan Kebangsaan

(Perisytiharan Warisan Kebangsaan) (Objek Warisan) (No. 2) 2019.

Warisan Kebangsaan

2. Objek yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang telah diisytiharkan sebagai objek

warisan dalam Perisytiharan Objek Warisan (No. 3) 2016 [P.U (B) 390/2016] yang

disiarkan dalam Warta pada 1 September 2016 dan disenaraikan dalam Daftar

diisytiharkan sebagai Warisan Kebangsaan.

JADUAL

1. Syiling emas zaman pemerintahan Sultan Abdul Jalil Rahmat Shah (1718-1722),

Johor

2. Duit timah berbentuk ayam jantan Sultan Muhammad Jiwa Zainal Azilin

Mu'adzam Shah II (1710-1773), Kedah

3. Syiling emas kupang (bulat) zaman pemerintahan Sultan Abdul Jalil Riayat

Shah II (1571-1597), Johor

4. Syiling emas kupang (segi lapan) zaman pemerintahan Sultan Abdul Jalil Riayat

Shah II (1571-1597), Johor

5. Syiling emas kupang zaman pemerintahan Sultan Alauddin Riayat Shah III

(1597-1615), Johor

6. Syiling perak suku penjuru zaman pemerintahan Sultan Abdul Jalil Shah III

(1623-1677), Johor

7. Syiling tembaga tarra zaman pemerintahan Sultan Dhiauddin Mukarram Shah

(1661-1687), Kedah

8. Syiling emas kupang zaman pemerintahan Sultan Dhiauddin Mukarram Shah

(1661-1687), Kedah

9. Syiling emas mas zaman pemerintahan Sultan Mahmud Shah II (1685-1699),

Johor

10. Syiling perak satu penjuru zaman pemerintahan Sultan Sulaiman Badrul Alam

Shah (1722-1760), Johor

11. Syiling perak suku penjuru zaman pemerintahan Sultan Sulaiman Badrul Alam

Shah (1722-1760), Johor

12. Duit tampang Pahang 1/16 dolar 1235 Hijrah (1898) zaman pemerintahan

Bendahara Sewa Raja Tun Ali (1806-1857), Pahang

13. Syiling timah setengah pitis zaman pemerintahan Sultan Muzaffar Shah

(1445-1459), Melaka

14. Syiling emas mas zaman pemerintahan Sultan Abdul Jalil Shah III (1623-1677),

Johor

15. Syiling timah pitis zaman pemerintahan Sultan Ibrahim Shah (1782-1826),

Selangor

Bertarikh 14 Ogos 2019

[JWN.PUU.600-1/3/1; PN(PU2)652/XVII)

DATUK MOHAMADDIN BIN KETAPI

Menteri Pelancongan, Seni dan Budaya Malaysia

NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE OBJECT) (NO. 2) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the National

Heritage Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of

National Heritage) (Heritage Object) (No. 2) Order 2019.

National Heritage

2. The objects specified in the Schedule that have been declared as heritage objects

in the Declaration of Heritage Object 2016 (No. 3) [P.U. (B) 390/2016] as published

in the Gazette on 1 September 2016 and listed in the Register are declared to be

National Heritage.

SCHEDULE

1. The gold coin in the reign of Sultan Abdul Jalil Rahmat Shah (1718-1722), Johore

2. The cockerel shaped tin coin of Sultan Muhammad Jiwa Zainal Azilin Mu'adzam

Shah II (1710-1773), Kedah

3. The kupang gold coin (circular) in the reign of Sultan Abdul Jalil Riayat Shah II

(1571-1597), Johore

4. The kupang gold coin (octagonal) in the reign of Sultan Abdul Jalil Riayat Shah II

(1571-1597), Johore

5. The kupang gold coin in the reign ofSultan Alauddin Riayat Shah III (1597-1615),

Johore

6. The silver quarter penjuru coin in the reign of Sultan Abdul Jalil Shah III

(1623-1677), Johore

7. The copper tarra coin in the reign of Sultan Dhiauddin Mukarram Shah

(1661-1687), Kedah

8. The kupang gold coin in the reign of Sultan Dhiauddin Mukarram Shah

(1661-1687), Kedah

9. The mas gold coin in the reign of Sultan Mahmud Shah II (1685-1699), Johore

10. The silver one penjuru coin in the reign of Sultan Sulaiman Badrul Alam Shah

(1722-1760), Johore

11. The silver quarter penjuru coin in the reign of Sultan Sulaiman Badrul Alam Shah

(1722-1760), Johore

12. The 1/16 dollar tampang Pahang 1235 Hijrah (1898) in the reign of Bendahara

Sewa Raja Tun Ali (1806-1857), Pahang

13. The half pitis tin coin in the reign of Sultan Muzaffar Shah (1445-1459), Malacca

14. The mas gold coin in the reign of Sultan Abdul Jalil Shah III (1623-1677), Johore

15. The tin pitis coin in the reign of Sultan Ibrahim Shah (1782-1826), Selangor

Dated 14 August 2019

[JWN.PUU.600-1/3/1; PN(PU2)652/XVII)
